question_en: How many projects; sites or countries does this post cover?
question_fr: Combien de projets; sites ou pays ce poste couvre-t-il?
why_en: Candidates need the scale of the portfolio to judge fit and workload.
why_fr: Les candidats ont besoin de l’échelle du portefeuille pour juger de l’adéquation et de la charge.
evidence_note: Option A sealed scores: portfolio-count pattern in 3/13 high-specificity vs 2/7 lower; also measured duty groups on project implementation and field management (Estimate; bottom n small).
label: Estimate

question_en: Which donors or funding sources does the post manage or report to?
question_fr: Quels bailleurs ou financements ce poste gère-t-il ou rapporte-t-il?
why_en: Donor rules drive reporting; compliance and what candidates must already know.
why_fr: Les règles des bailleurs structurent le reporting; la conformité et ce que les candidats doivent déjà connaître.
evidence_note: Top specificity band 6/13 vs bottom 1/7 on donor wording in sealed Option A pretags (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: Which partners; authorities or consortium members does the post work with?
question_fr: Avec quels partenaires; autorités ou membres de consortium le poste travaille-t-il?
why_en: Vague stakeholder lines hide who the post actually coordinates with.
why_fr: Des formulations floues sur les parties prenantes cachent avec qui le poste coordonne vraiment.
evidence_note: Partner/counterpart wording slightly richer in the high-specificity sealed band; partners-government is a large measured duty group (Fact for group size; Estimate for keep-rule).
label: Estimate

question_en: What reports or deliverables are due; and how often?
question_fr: Quels rapports ou livrables sont attendus; et à quelle fréquence?
why_en: Cadence and named outputs separate a real programme post from filler duties.
why_fr: La cadence et des livrables nommés distinguent un vrai poste programme d’un texte générique.
evidence_note: kind_deadline_or_output in 6/13 high-specificity vs 1/7 lower sealed Option A pretags; donor-reporting and progress-tracking are large measured groups (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: Who does the post report to; and how many staff does it manage?
question_fr: À qui le poste rend-il compte; et combien de personnes encadre-t-il?
why_en: CHCF job-description order treats reporting line and staff managed as facts the advert should state.
why_fr: L’outil CHCF place la ligne hiérarchique et l’encadrement parmi les faits que l’annonce devrait indiquer.
evidence_note: CHCF section order (std); sealed Option A staff-managed pattern weak (2/13 vs 1/7). Keep as standards-required (Estimate).
label: Estimate

fact: Humanitarian accountability (feedback; safeguarding; do no harm)
question_en: For this humanitarian context: how do people give feedback or complain; and what safeguarding or do-no-harm expectations apply?
question_fr: Pour ce contexte humanitaire: comment les personnes font-elles un retour ou une plainte; et quelles attentes de sauvegarde ou de ne pas nuire s’appliquent?
why_en: CHS accountability block is not a duty list; the chat asks so the advert states real mechanisms instead of empty claims.
why_fr: Le bloc CHS n’est pas une liste de tâches; le chat demande pour que l’annonce cite des mécanismes réels plutôt que des affirmations vides.
evidence_note: Standards-required for humanitarian programme templates (19.21); top band also shows more feedback/safeguarding wording (Estimate). Templates do not insert the CHS name by default.
label: Estimate

question_en: Which indicators or results framework (for example a logframe) does the post own or support?
question_fr: Quels indicateurs ou cadre de résultats (par exemple un cadre logique) le poste possède-t-il ou appuie-t-il?
why_en: Without named indicators; MEAL duties collapse into generic monitoring language.
why_fr: Sans indicateurs nommés; les tâches MEAL se réduisent à un suivi générique.
evidence_note: Indicators wording in 4/17 high-specificity sealed Option A vs 0/3 lower (Estimate; bottom n=3).
label: Estimate

fact: Data and MEL tools or systems
question_en: Which data or MEL tools or systems does the post use (for example Kobo; DHIS; ActivityInfo; Power BI)?
question_fr: Quels outils ou systèmes de données ou de S&E le poste utilise-t-il (par exemple Kobo; DHIS; ActivityInfo; Power BI)?
why_en: Named tools tell candidates the stack and the specificity the role needs.
why_fr: Des outils nommés indiquent la stack et le niveau de précision attendu.
evidence_note: Measured duty groups centre on data quality and MEAL tools; sealed kind_standard_or_tool richer in the top band (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: How are findings used for learning or adaptive management; and with whom?
question_fr: Comment les résultats sont-ils utilisés pour l’apprentissage ou la gestion adaptative; et avec qui?
why_en: MEAL posts that never say how learning is used read as data collection only.
why_fr: Un poste MEAL qui ne dit jamais comment l’apprentissage est utilisé se lit comme de la seule collecte de données.
evidence_note: Learning wording in 9/17 high-specificity vs 1/3 lower; learning-collaborative is a measured group (Estimate).
label: Estimate

fact: Geographic or programme coverage for MEAL
question_en: Which programmes; sites or populations does the MEAL work cover?
question_fr: Quels programmes; sites ou populations le travail S&E couvre-t-il?
why_en: Coverage facts stop generic MEAL text that could fit any country office.
why_fr: Les faits de couverture empêchent un texte MEAL générique valable pour n’importe quel bureau.
evidence_note: Portfolio/coverage counts in 5/17 high-specificity sealed Option A vs 0/3 lower (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: How do affected people give feedback or complain about the response this MEAL post supports?
question_fr: Comment les personnes affectées font-elles un retour ou une plainte sur la réponse que ce poste MEAL appuie?
why_en: CHS commitments on feedback and complaints belong in the humanitarian accountability block; not as invented MEAL duties.
why_fr: Les engagements CHS sur les retours et plaintes appartiennent au bloc de redevabilité; pas comme des tâches MEAL inventées.
evidence_note: Standards-required (19.21); MEAL often owns or supports the mechanism (Estimate). Templates do not insert the CHS name by default.
label: Estimate

question_en: Who are the primary audiences for this post’s communications or advocacy?
question_fr: Quels sont les publics prioritaires des communications ou du plaidoyer de ce poste?
why_en: Audience is the signature fact that separates a real communications brief from channel filler.
why_fr: Le public est le fait signature qui distingue un vrai brief communication d’un remplissage sur les canaux.
evidence_note: Audience wording in 6/15 high-specificity sealed Option A vs 0/5 lower; audiences-communications is a measured group (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: Which channels or products must the post deliver (for example press; social; newsletter; events)?
question_fr: Quels canaux ou produits le poste doit-il livrer (par exemple presse; réseaux sociaux; newsletter; événements)?
why_en: Candidates need the channel mix to judge craft skills and workload.
why_fr: Les candidats ont besoin du mix de canaux pour juger des compétences et de la charge.
evidence_note: Channel/media wording is common in both bands; kept because measured groups (media; social; newsletters; events) show it as core role content (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: What change; policy ask or campaign objective should the work advance?
question_fr: Quel changement; demande politique ou objectif de campagne le travail doit-il faire avancer?
why_en: Without an ask or objective; advocacy lines stay ornamental.
why_fr: Sans demande ou objectif; les lignes de plaidoyer restent décoratives.
evidence_note: Advocacy wording in 7/15 high-specificity vs 2/5 lower; advocacy-initiative is a measured group (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: Which languages must the post write or speak for public or partner communications?
question_fr: Quelles langues le poste doit-il écrire ou parler pour les communications publiques ou partenaires?
why_en: Language is a genuine requirement for communications posts and must not be left implied.
why_fr: La langue est une exigence réelle pour les postes communication et ne doit pas rester implicite.
evidence_note: Broad-layer languages fact is often missing from communications adverts; kept as a role signature check (Estimate; not from sealed specificity delta).
label: Estimate

question_en: If this is a humanitarian post: what may be said publicly; and what safeguarding or do-no-harm limits apply to content?
question_fr: Si ce poste est humanitaire: que peut-on dire publiquement; et quelles limites de sauvegarde ou de ne pas nuire s’appliquent au contenu?
why_en: CHS do-no-harm and respectful communications sit in the accountability block; the chat asks rather than inventing copy rules.
why_fr: Le CHS (ne pas nuire; communications respectueuses) relève du bloc de redevabilité; le chat demande au lieu d’inventer des règles de contenu.
evidence_note: Standards-required when the organisation type is humanitarian (19.21); sealed feedback/safeguarding wording present in both bands (Estimate).
label: Estimate

question_en: Which donors’ financial rules or grant conditions does the post apply?
question_fr: Quelles règles financières ou conditions de subvention de bailleurs le poste applique-t-il?
why_en: Donor financial rules are the finance signature fact candidates need before a JD is written.
why_fr: Les règles financières des bailleurs sont le fait signature dont les candidats ont besoin avant la rédaction.
evidence_note: Donor wording in 9/18 high-specificity sealed Option A vs 0/2 lower; donor-financial is a measured group (Estimate; bottom n=2). No ACCA competencies invented.
label: Estimate

question_en: Which accounting or finance system does the post use (for example ERP; SAP; Sage)?
question_fr: Quel système comptable ou financier le poste utilise-t-il (par exemple ERP; SAP; Sage)?
why_en: Named systems are the technical specificity finance adverts often omit.
why_fr: Les systèmes nommés sont la précision technique que les annonces finance omettent souvent.
evidence_note: Accounting/system wording in 11/18 high-specificity vs 0/2 lower; systems-financial is a measured group (Estimate). No ACCA competencies invented.
label: Estimate

question_en: What budget size or envelope does the post manage or support?
question_fr: Quelle taille de budget ou d’enveloppe le poste gère-t-il ou appuie-t-il?
why_en: Budget scale tells candidates the seniority and risk of the finance post.
why_fr: L’échelle budgétaire indique l’ancienneté et le risque du poste finance.
evidence_note: Budget-amount pattern common in sealed Option A; kept as section 9 finance signature fact (Estimate). No ACCA competencies invented.
label: Estimate

question_en: What internal or external audit or assurance work does the post prepare for or support?
question_fr: Quel travail d’audit ou d’assurance interne ou externe le poste prépare-t-il ou appuie-t-il?
why_en: Audit is a dominant measured finance duty group; candidates need the cycle named.
why_fr: L’audit est un groupe de tâches finance mesuré dominant; les candidats ont besoin du cycle nommé.
evidence_note: Audit wording in most sealed Option A finance adverts; audit-audits is the largest measured group (Fact for group size). No ACCA competencies invented.
label: Estimate

question_en: Which monthly; quarterly or annual financial reports does the post own?
question_fr: Quels rapports financiers mensuels; trimestriels ou annuels le poste possède-t-il?
why_en: Cadence turns generic financial management into a checkable duty.
why_fr: La cadence transforme une gestion financière générique en tâche vérifiable.
evidence_note: kind_frequency in 6/18 high-specificity vs 0/2 lower; monthly-quarterly is a large measured group (Estimate). No ACCA competencies invented.
label: Estimate

question_en: Does this post include responsibilities for ethical stewardship of funds or resources; and how is that stated?
question_fr: Ce poste inclut-il des responsabilités de gestion éthique des fonds ou ressources; et comment est-ce formulé?
why_en: CHS ninth commitment is organisational resource ethics in the accountability block; not a finance competency list from ACCA.
why_fr: Le neuvième engagement CHS est l’éthique des ressources au niveau organisationnel; ce n’est pas une liste de compétences ACCA.
evidence_note: Standards mapping from 19.21 (CHS resource ethics; not ACCA). Sealed feedback/safeguarding wording present (Estimate). Templates do not insert the CHS name by default.
label: Estimate
